slides.title:
PHYSICAL GTA VI
NO DISC?
slides.desc: Yes. Rockstar confirms a digital code inside the physical Standard box.
slides.alt: Cover slide: LaunchReady Gaming explains that the GTA VI physical Standard Edition is code-in-box rather than a game disc. A stylized original illustration shows a retail-style box and the text download code, no disc.

slides.title:
WHAT IS
IN THE BOX?
slides.desc: A redeemable download code for GTA VI. No game disc. The physical box is not a disc-install edition.
slides.alt: Slide two explains Rockstar’s confirmed physical GTA VI format: a retail box with a digital download code rather than a disc, so installation requires downloading the game.

slides.title:
CHECK THE
ACCOUNT REGION
slides.desc: PlayStation: the code region must match your account region group. Xbox codes are not region-locked, per Rockstar.
slides.alt: Slide three: PlayStation GTA VI code redemption follows account region groups; Rockstar says Xbox download codes are not region-locked. Players should check their platform account and retail region before buying.

slides.title:
PRE-BUY
CHECKLIST
slides.desc:
01 Check console platform.
02 Check account region.
03 Verify the retailer and code region.
04 Redeem on the correct account.
slides.alt: Slide four presents four practical steps for GTA VI code-in-box shoppers: identify platform, inspect account region, check seller and code region, then redeem with the intended account.

slides.title:
CHECK YOUR
CODE FIRST
slides.desc: Open LaunchReady’s free PlayStation Code Region Group Checker. Link in @launchready_gaming bio.
slides.alt: Final slide shows an actual result screen from the LaunchReady Gaming PlayStation code region checker with different selected account and purchase regions, inviting users to access the free tool through the profile link.

carousels.caption: Which consoles can actually play GTA VI? Rockstar confirms PS5 and Xbox Series X|S launch editions. Xbox One is a cloud-streaming option, not a native GTA VI install. No announced PC or PS4 launch edition in the checked official listing. Read our free guide through the link in bio. Independent fan resource. #GTA6 #XboxOne #PS5 #XboxSeriesX

slides.title:
CAN YOUR
CONSOLE PLAY?
slides.desc: Do not confuse local installation with cloud streaming.
slides.alt: First slide asks where GTA VI can run and previews PS5, Xbox Series X or S as launch platforms and Xbox One as a cloud option.

slides.title:
LOCAL
GAME EDITIONS
slides.desc: Rockstar lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S for pre-order and release. These are the announced native launch platforms.
slides.alt: Second slide confirms Rockstar officially lists PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X or S for GTA VI console editions at launch.

slides.title:
XBOX ONE:
YES, VIA CLOUD
slides.desc: Rockstar announced Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One. That is streaming, not a local Xbox One installation.
slides.alt: Third slide distinguishes GTA VI playable via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One from an unannounced native Xbox One game installation, with performance dependent on connection conditions.

slides.title:
WHAT ABOUT
PC OR PS4?
slides.desc: Neither has a launch edition announced in Rockstar’s current platform FAQ. That does not establish what may happen later.
slides.alt: Fourth slide explains that Rockstar’s current GTA VI platform list does not announce PC or PlayStation 4 versions for launch and avoids claiming they can never be released.

slides.title:
CHECK YOUR
PLAY OPTIONS
slides.desc: See our Xbox Cloud Play guide and console compatibility details. Open profile → free GTA VI tools.
slides.alt: Final slide displays a real screenshot of LaunchReady Gaming’s Xbox Cloud Play guide explaining the cloud-only Xbox One route, with directions to open the guide from the Instagram profile link.

carousels.caption: GTA VI Standard vs Ultimate: Standard includes the game. Ultimate adds Rockstar-listed bonus vehicles, styles and other content. Rockstar confirms a separate Ultimate Edition Upgrade is available later, including for physical Standard owners after code redemption. Compare using our free Edition Choice Helper: link in bio. Independent fan resource. #GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Ultimate

slides.title:
STANDARD OR
ULTIMATE?
slides.desc: Choose based on the extras, not assumptions about the core game.
slides.alt: Opening comparison slide asks whether GTA VI Standard or Ultimate is right for the buyer, with original illustrated cards for the two editions.

slides.title:
STANDARD:
THE FULL GAME
slides.desc: Standard includes Grand Theft Auto VI. It does not automatically include the Ultimate Edition upgrade.
slides.alt: Slide two: Rockstar’s official FAQ says GTA VI Standard Edition contains the full game, while additional Ultimate upgrades are separate.

slides.title:
ULTIMATE:
EXTRA CONTENT
slides.desc: Includes the game plus the published Ultimate upgrade, with vehicles, styling and additional in-game items.
slides.alt: Third slide lists the Ultimate Edition as the complete GTA VI game plus Rockstar-announced bonus content, including vehicles, styling and other items unveiled through the story.

slides.title:
YOU CAN
UPGRADE LATER
slides.desc: Standard owners can buy the Ultimate upgrade separately. Physical Standard owners can upgrade after redeeming their code.
slides.alt: Fourth slide clarifies Rockstar permits purchasing the Ultimate Edition Upgrade later, including for physical Standard Edition buyers after their digital code has been redeemed.

slides.title:
MAKE A
BETTER CHOICE
slides.desc: Set your priorities in the free Edition Choice Helper. No invented price comparison.
slides.alt: Fifth slide embeds a genuine LaunchReady Gaming Edition Choice Helper result with Ultimate digital and extra content selected, explaining that the site offers information rather than a live price quote.

Browser storage can be cleared, so export if you need a backup. Try free in @launchready_gaming bio. Independent fan-created planner. #GTA6 #PlayDesk #GamingPlanner

FIRST SESSION

slides.alt: Opening Play Desk tutorial slide introduces three genuine actions in the independent LaunchReady browser tool: add a goal, save a note and export a backup.

YOUR GOAL

slides.alt: Second slide shows an actual LaunchReady My Play Desk browser interaction after adding the example personal goal Explore the Leonida coastline to the goals list.

slides.title:
02. SAVE
A PLAY NOTE
slides.desc: Write a reminder for later. The note remains in this browser while local data is retained.
slides.alt: Third slide displays the real My Play Desk note field with example text about exploring coastal roads and keeping screenshots, demonstrating a user-written local note.

slides.title:

A BACKUP
slides.desc: Use Export backup before clearing browser storage or switching devices. It is not a GTA VI save file.
slides.alt: Fourth slide captures the genuine Export backup button in My Play Desk and explains exported planner data is separate from Rockstar’s in-game saves.

slides.title:
MAKE IT
YOUR OWN
slides.desc: Goals, notes and a downloadable backup — free at LaunchReady Gaming.
